description: Compact the session's stored history: older messages are replaced by one summary so the next run starts lean. Deletes the summarized messages and cannot be undone. Spends a small model call on your credential. Refused while a run is active.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional. Send the same key when retrying this exact call after a lost answer ("fetch failed"): the first call's result comes back and nothing is written twice. Reusing a key with different arguments is refused with idempotency_key_reused. 8-120 letters, digits, "_" or "-".

name: anyforge_compact_studio_session
title: Compact studio session
